diffs.change: composed per COMPOSITION.md — frontmatter aligned to skill/1.0 schema, io_contract added, triggers generated from task verbs
created with source attribution + first-application record

sandbox_trace.backend: native-isolated-dir (no docker/seatbelt available; fs writes confined to ~/.ciel/sandbox/)

coherence.rationale: Aligns with orchestration philosophy: composes existing skills + one new primitive instead of monolithic import; documented flow respects component risk model.

capability.rationale: Fills a genuine gap — no existing skill converts images to Hermes rich-markup banner art. Procedure is complete, tested end-to-end on the CIEL build, and includes both converter and Pillow paths.

safety.rationale: Writes confined to skins dir; activation via sanctioned 'hermes config set' only; no network at runtime; sandbox trace clean (zero network attempts, zero outside-sandbox writes). Risk classified low.

efficiency.rationale: Small L0 footprint; reuses ascii-art knowledge. Minor overlap with generic image-to-ASCII tools, justified by the rich-markup conversion primitive that nothing else provides.

evolution.rationale: Self-improvement ready: pitfalls section captures the indent bug and aspect-ratio lessons as structured guidance; outcome scoring can track future skin builds.
